Hi Samira,

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming renewal. We’d like to combine the QBR with a focused roadmap/demo session that highlights the new batching and quantization improvements — should be useful as you evaluate next-year commitments.

Proposed structure (90 minutes):
- 15m: exec summary + goals for renewal
- 30m: roadmap demo (Marissa to run technical deep-dive)
- 25m: procurement & timing (commercial + legal questions)
- 20m: mutual action plan & next steps

Candidate dates (US Pacific):
- Tue Oct 14, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Oct 15, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Oct 16, 09:00–10:30 PT

Can you confirm preferred dates and who from your side should join (procurement, security, product)? I’ll loop in Marissa and Laura to own the demo and procurement checklist respectively.

Attaching a draft agenda for quick review.

[Attachment: QBR-Agenda-v1.docx (Word, 22KB)]
